newsitem.title: USA: Philadelphia Orchestra musicians vote to end strike.
newsitem.headline: Philadelphia Orchestra musicians vote to end strike.

text.p: Musicians of the Philadelphia Orchestra voted late on Monday to end their 64-day strike.

The members of the American Federation of Musicians voted 54-47 to accept terms that ended their first strike in 30 years. The work stoppage forced orchestra management to cancel two months of its 1996-97 season.

The orchestra's 103 musicians and two librarians began the strike on Sept. 16. The breakthrough agreements on health care benfits and fewer free concerts was mediated by David Cohen, a member of Philadelphia Mayor Ed Rendell's staff.
The orchestra will give a concert in the Academy of Music on Tuesday.
